existing power and memory guard policies
limitations: 16K synthetic English code and Korean reasoning prompts are not general task accuracy benchmarks.
Sampled outputs differ between some runs; small full-model TPS changes cannot establish a win.
Zero new swap-out does not mean zero system-wide SSD writes.

changes.1: aligned 32-bit reads with bit stitching, original block layout
changes.2: lossless ql/qh/scales/delta planes, same total packed bytes

static_findings: Q6 kernels already specialize exact column counts; no five-to-eight-column padding waste.
DFlash2 follows its dedicated selector path; backend_sampling switches do not activate the ordinary draft sampler.

flash_profile.scope: 16K English prompt, 256 output tokens; timestamp profiling adds overhead
flash_profile.finding: GPU verification dominates. Eliminating only the measured recurrence component caps speedup near 1.019x.

tree_wy.status: numerical reference verified; no GPU port or deployment
tree_wy.equivalent_form: g_t=prod(alpha); L_ti=beta_t*(g_t/g_i)*dot(k_t,k_i) for i<t, L_tt=1; U=solve(L,R); R_t=beta_t*(v_t-g_t*S_0*k_t)
tree_wy.applicability: Strata already replays accepted recurrent state without full per-node snapshots, so advertised snapshot savings are not new savings here.
tree_wy.inverse_warning: Undoing updates by division by 1-beta*||k||^2 can amplify errors 100000x at normalized k and beta=.99999.

hc_cold_weight_microbench.scope: BF16 weights, production-like Q8 activation producer, eight cold weight sets, T=1..6
hc_cold_weight_microbench.warning: Kernel speedup is not whole-model speedup.

research_directions.name: ReaDy
research_directions.finding: Reported 3.16x is versus plain autoregressive decoding; reported extra gain versus DSpark is 7.97%. Validated stack is B200/CUDA/SGLang, greedy BF16 at 16K. Needs a trained recurrent-state reader and matching draft, GGUF/HIP port, RANA and stochastic-sampler validation.

research_directions.name: DLite
research_directions.finding: History-free trained drafter can reduce draft KV cost; published small-model/H800 results do not establish EVO 27B/Flash gains. No matching 27B/Flash trained draft verified.

research_directions.name: TreeWY
research_directions.finding: Large auxiliary-state savings compare with full snapshots. Already-replay Strata and measured recurrence fraction substantially limit relevance here.

research_directions.name: Target-specific trained drafter / AEON DFlash2
research_directions.status: reviewed; gated weights, no download or EVO test
research_directions.finding: Author reports roughly 35% gain over stock DFlash2 at temperature 1 on DGX Spark using a different AEON target. AMD, llama.cpp, RANA and the current release served speed are unverified. This supports investigating matched draft training, not claiming a drop-in EVO gain.

q27_twenty_tok_s_condition.scope: Prior 512-token Korean run, fixed-time-window approximation; not a promise
q27_twenty_tok_s_condition.finding: Approximately 11.6% less time per window or 13.1% more accepted output per window is needed. The tried Q6 load changes do not provide it.

build_incident.cause: First private build accidentally included server UI/node and exceeded its isolated 5GiB cgroup limit.
build_incident.resolution: Restored production model, disabled UI/server/tools and rebuilt only GPU library with an 8GiB no-swap build limit.

hc_adaptive_full_model.decision: not adopted; small short-run gains did not hold consistently in longer output confirmation

hc_adaptive_long_confirmation.numerical_limit: The 1024-token Korean output differs. Kernel-level bit exactness does not establish whole-model bit exactness; the cause of this sampled divergence was not isolated. The candidate already fails the speed-first criterion and was not deployed.

q6_prefill_scratch_expansion.scope: Q6 to temporary F16 cast plus matmul; GPU microbenchmark, not model TPS; rounding can change
q6_prefill_scratch_expansion.decision: rejected; all tested shapes slower and extra scratch needed

final_state.reason: No consistent throughput gain; long Korean decode slightly regressed.
final_state.oom_explanation: Global counter increased 2 to 3 in isolated first UI compiler build; no inference OOM.
